methods.name: BRC completion-gap residue difference jet
triggers: avoid big integer modulo in BRC cascade
compose energy jet with square tables
capabilities: transport floor(sqrt(mN)) modulo a registered table-product on each of five stride-eight source orbits
reuse the exact root third difference already emitted by the square-increment energy jet
transport mN modulo the same product by the exact sparse-step recurrence t<-t+h*(N mod M)

seed all root-residue orbits with exactly fifteen full-root reductions plus two one-time target reductions
COMPACT profile tests 4032 and 12155 before materializing the full completion gap

preserve zero false negatives and exact equality with the existing BALANCED cascade

methods.core_law: On one source orbit m_k=m_0+8k, let j_k=J_k mod M, v_k=nabla J_k mod M and a_k=nabla^2 J_k mod M. If w_(k+1)=nabla^3 J_(k+1) is supplied exactly by the parent energy jet, then j_(k+1)=j_k+v_k+a_k+w_(k+1), v_(k+1)=v_k+a_k+w_(k+1), and a_(k+1)=a_k+w_(k+1) modulo M. With t_m=mN mod M transported by t_(m+h)=t_m+h*(N mod M), the nonzero upward completion gap satisfies F_m mod M=(j_m+1)^2-t_m mod M. Therefore the registered square-residue tables can be evaluated exactly before F_m is materialized.
methods.hard_boundary: This is an exact modular-observer and execution optimization extending existing T0_BRC tools. It does not reduce the multiplier horizon or factor-search complexity. Finite CPython timings are mixed below several thousand bits and show only a modest incremental gain on large operands; no machine-independent crossover is claimed. PRIMARY/COMPACT/FULL must remain necessary-condition filters, and root/remainder plus modular provenance must not be collapsed into a Boolean table result before downstream exact checks.
